description: A WPF app migrated to MSIX reads the assembly version instead of the installed package version, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/62161949/read-msix-package-appxmanifest-version.
prompt:
We moved an in-house WPF app from ClickOnce to MSIX and the window title now shows the wrong version. The package manifest has the version I want users to see, but `Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()` still returns the app assembly version.

Can you tell me what code/project change I should make?
